extract.lead: Announcements An update on independent evaluators Oct 15, 2026 Last month, we committed to stronger independent, third-party assessment of our models and safety practices. We also signed the White House Accord on Super Intelligence, in which companies pledged to partner with independent external auditors or evaluators. Today, we’re announcing that we’ve started to give employee-like access to a team from METR , a nonprofit that evaluates frontier AI models. METR will publish the results of its risk assessments. Over the past year, we’ve worked with METR on several reviews of our Risk Reports . We’re also working with SecureBio and Accenture as evaluators, and are in early discussions with several other organizations, including Hugging Face .
